description: Everything about one plan by slug: description, specs, included and excluded features, location, availability, and every billing cycle with its price, setup fee, monthly equivalent and cart link.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. USD or AED. Defaults to USD. An unsupported code returns an error listing the valid ones.

slug.description: Product slug as returned by search_products, recommend_plan or list_categories.
